power_domains_summary.VREFCA: CA reference (VDD/2); stable in all states.
power_domains_summary.VREFDQ: DQ reference (VDDQ/2); stable in all states.
power_domains_summary.VPP: 2.5 V wordline pump supply (new in DDR4).

power_up_sequence: 1. Assert RESET# LOW (≤ 0.2 × VDD) and CKE LOW.
4. RESET# LOW ≥ 200 µs after stable power.
6. Start CK; ≥ 10 ns or 5 nCK stable before CKE.
7. CKE HIGH with NOP/DES; wait tXPR.
8. MRS(MR2, MR3, MR1, MR0 with DLL Reset) → ZQCL → tDLLK + tZQinit.

low_power_modes_summary.Active_Power_Down: CKE LOW with bank open; tXP exit.
low_power_modes_summary.Precharge_Power_Down_Fast_Exit: CKE LOW, MR0 A12=1; tXP exit.
low_power_modes_summary.Precharge_Power_Down_Slow_Exit: CKE LOW, MR0 A12=0; tXPDLL exit.
low_power_modes_summary.Self_Refresh: CKE LOW self-refresh with Auto Self-Refresh (ASR) and temperature-controlled / low-power ranges.
low_power_modes_summary.Maximum_Power_Saving_Mode: Deep idle low-power mode (MR4) for DDR4.

rows: Refresh rate appropriate for Normal or Extended Range

fields.notes: DDR4 power intent is the 1.2 V VDD/VDDQ + 2.5 V VPP rail set with the CKE-controlled power-down / self-refresh / MPSM states and ODT/DBI/refresh energy features. Fine-grained controller power domains are an SoC concern.

power_management_states.name: Active
power_management_states.description: Normal command operation; banks may be active.

power_management_states.name: Precharge PD
power_management_states.description: CKE LOW with all banks precharged; fast exit.

power_management_states.name: Active PD
power_management_states.description: CKE LOW with a row open.

power_management_states.name: Self-Refresh
power_management_states.description: CKE LOW; the DRAM refreshes itself (ASR / temperature-controlled / LP).

fields.wakeup_mechanism: Power-down and self-refresh are entered/exited via CKE (and the self-refresh command); exit observes the defined power-down / self-refresh exit timings before commands resume.

power_rails.purpose: Wordline / activating pump supply (new in DDR4).

fields.ddr4_power_considerations: DDR4 lowers VDD/VDDQ to 1.2 V (from DDR3's 1.5 V) and adds a separate VPP = 2.5 V wordline pump rail. Data Bus Inversion, Rtt_PARK, Fine Granularity Refresh, temperature-controlled refresh, power-down, and Maximum Power Saving Mode all reduce energy.

extraction_hints: Look for power-domain partitioning, supply nets.
